name: Strasserwirt
beschreibung: The Strasserwirt is a storied, traditional inn in St. Johann in Tirol, set against the scenic mountain backdrop of the Kaiserwald forest. The property harmoniously combines Tyrolean charm with modern amenities, featuring wood-panelled dining parlours, authentic local cuisine showcasing regional specialities, and comfortable rooms with alpine character. Guests prize the inn both as a launchpad for hikes and ski tours in the Kaiser Mountains and as a peaceful retreat after active days in nature. The inn provides a warm, relaxed atmosphere for restorative holidays.
